plugins.name: playback-lens
plugins.description: Search and replay your own Claude Code history: every prompt, tool call and file operation, by event kind, tool and date — plus cost and token accounting that flags and repairs unpriced models. Bundles the Playback Lens MCP server and a skill that teaches the model when to reach for it.
